title: A contact transaction that threw after its observation committed escaped apply, so the consumed observation was redelivered and nothing was logged
resolution: The contact transaction is wrapped in a catch that turns a thrown error into an internal failure, logged as execution.observation.contact-unrecorded with redacted fields; apply keeps the consumed outcome. A thrown-error test failed before.

title: The best-effort contact conflicted with successful-contact scenarios of observation-consumption and worker-contact, and the record said no worker-contact delta was needed
resolution: A worker-contact MODIFIED Lost contact delta (498 characters) refers to the best-effort contact and adds a failed-contact scenario; the successful-contact scenarios say the contact is recorded; verification.md corrected.

title: The revocation scenario promised an unreachable worker, although revocation leaves the reachable flag alone
resolution: Retirement and revocation are separate scenarios: revocation leaves the last contact unchanged and the worker ineligible for placement; a PostgreSQL test of a reachable worker revoked before its contact covers it.

title: The held-row test was called the deterministic proof, although it shows only the blocking dependency, not the retry exhaustion or redelivery
resolution: verification.md calls it a deterministic regression test of the blocking dependency and names the diagnosis and the load runs as the evidence for starvation; the redelivery claim is qualified.

title: The record said no assertion changed, although two unit-test transaction-count assertions changed
resolution: verification.md says no G2 scenario timeout, retry count, or assertion changed, and lists the unit-test transaction-count changes separately.

title: A contact transaction that threw, a store defect, was logged at warn with code internal like a transient contact miss
resolution: A thrown contact transaction is logged at error level with reason threw, and a returned failure stays at warn; apply keeps the consumed outcome. The thrown-contact test asserts the level and the reason and failed before.

title: recordContactOf, recordContact and recordCurrentContact sat in one flow and authenticated differently without saying so
resolution: recordContactOf is renamed recordUnconsumedContact, and its comment says that it goes through authenticateObserver, which may replace the producer's journal.

title: No test exercised the two failure branches of recordCurrentContact
resolution: A heartbeat-service test returns the outage of a failing fleet.worker read and of a failing reports.recordContact write; a mutation of both branches made it fail.

title: The author self-check cited observation-service.ts:50-58 for apply, whose lines are 51-59
resolution: The citation is :51-59, and every other line citation of the change was checked against the tree; the shifted observation-service.ts ranges and the try/finally range of the held-row test were corrected.

title: The records placed e and h on make verify's known-flake list, which does not exist in the repository
resolution: verification.md and proposal.md say that the coordinator's known-flake list lives in Zaki's briefs and the coordinator's queue, and a follow-up says that e and h leave it after integration.
